ops.old: Crisp black sesame and parmesan crackers cut into cat shapes, with a whipped feta and honey dip for little paws. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 50g grated parmesan, 40g black sesame seeds and half a tsp salt. Add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to form a dough. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut out cat shapes. Bake at 180C for 10 to 12 minutes until crisp. Blitz 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and 1 tbsp honey until smooth.
